summary.name: Kling AI MCP & CLI
summary.one_liner: A guide to connecting AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, OpenClaw, WorkBuddy) and terminals to Kling AI's image and video generation through a plugin, an MCP server, or a command-line tool.
use_cases: Generate videos from images or text prompts inside Claude, Cursor, or ChatGPT
Batch-generate videos from a terminal, script, or CI pipeline
Create reusable character or object Elements from reference images
Apply motion templates from the Motion Library to a subject image
Integrate Kling generation into ComfyUI, Makefiles, or shell pipelines
summary.what_it_does: The page documents three ways to access Kling's generation features: a client-specific plugin with one-click setup, a remote MCP server at kling.ai/mcp that AI assistants connect to via OAuth, and a CLI (kling) for direct terminal use. The MCP server exposes 18 tools, including text_to_video, image_to_video, text_to_image, image_to_image, omni_ref_video, motion_control, Element create/list/update/delete, query_tasks for polling results, and file_upload. The CLI mirrors these as commands, with a --poll flag to wait for completion. Generated file URLs remain valid for 24 hours according to the FAQ. The page advises installing only one of plugin, MCP, or CLI per assistant to avoid unpredictable selection.
notable: Single remote MCP endpoint (kling.ai/mcp) with OAuth sign-in, usable from multiple AI clients
CLI supports batch generation and scripting, including ComfyUI nodes and CI pipelines
Element library for reusable references from images or video
Rate limit of 5 QPS; non-subscribers limited to one concurrent video task
caveats: Uses paid credits from the Personal workspace only; Team workspace benefits and bonus credits are not available through MCP or CLI
Generation tasks cannot be canceled once submitted
Off-peak free generation is not available through AI assistants
